f_max_hz.evidence: The maximum SPI speed is 7 Mbit/s and fixed to CPOL = 0 and CPHA = 0.

interfaces.note: CPOL = 0, CPHA = 0, half duplex, BUSY handshake (data sheet p. 16)

evidence: IDD(TVDD) supply current on pin TVDD in still air with exposed pins
IDD(TVDD) supply current on pin TVDD in still air with exposed pins

current.note: PVDD about 20 mA and VBAT at most 20 mA on top (p. 119); limiting value 300 mA on TVDD (p. 116)

notes.text: PVDD sets the host interface level: only 1.8 V or 3.3 V, nothing between 1.95 V and 2.7 V.
notes.evidence: Only a voltage of 1.8 V or 3.3 V is supported, but no voltage in the range of 1.95 V to 2.7 V.

notes.text: The host must watch BUSY: it signals that the PN5180 cannot send or receive SPI data.
notes.evidence: The BUSY signal is used to indicate that the PN5180 is not able to send or receive data over the SPI interface.

notes.text: All VBAT pins must be connected.
notes.evidence: VBAT 12 supply Supply Connection, all VBAT mandatory to be connected

notes.text: Common PN5180 breakout boards have a 5 V pin (TVDD, full RF power) and a 3.3 V pin (PVDD/VBAT); the SPI levels follow the 3.3 V pin. Check the board.
